whyAlwaysLive.apps/files/src/app.tsx: The inspector renders with no selection — its body falls back to an `inspector__empty` hint and the Preview/Properties/Comments tab strip stays usable, so the toggle always changes what is on screen. Disabling it would remove a working panel.
